children: J.P. Morgan Private Bank, part of banking giant JPMorgan Chase
, is expanding its Fund Banking Group with a new hub in Dallas to serve the state's fast-growing private equity, venture capital, and hedge fund communities, the company said Wednesday.

"Texas has become a genuine center of gravity for private equity, venture capital, and hedge funds," said Jeff Kaveney, head of Fund Banking at J.P. Morgan Private Bank. "The pace of growth for the region is remarkable, and this new Fund Banking hub responds directly to that momentum."
has scaled the private bank platform quickly since it acquired First Republic Bank in 2023.

The Private Bank has been serving the private and venture fund spaces and their CEO for 30 years, Kaveney added. The platform has roughly doubled in the past three years. The team now has 40 fund bankers with plans to expand by at least 20% in the next three years.
The Dallas hub will start with two fund bankers, three dedicated private bankers, and a Dallas-based lending team, the company said in a statement.

title: J.P. Morgan Private Bank expanding in Dallas to tap alternative assets sector
